catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: net earnings $172.4M ($1.82 diluted EPS) vs $170.8M ($1.76/share) a year earlier; revenue $3.68B (+20% YoY, +13% ex-fuel surcharge); operating income $247.1M (+2%), with the operating margin narrowing ~1.2pp to 6.7% on higher driver, insurance and group-medical costs; Intermodal and a return to profit in Integrated Capacity Solutions offset declines in Dedicated, Final Mile and Truckload; 9-month diluted EPS $5.21 vs $4.24; FY2026 capex target held at $700M

conflicts: Market cap and shares outstanding are both from a 2026-07-06 snapshot (~3.5 months stale); an earlier same-aggregator reading on 2026-07-02 showed ~$26.95B, suggesting some intra-week movement even before the gap to October.

Short interest, mid-July 2026: MarketBeat reports 2,101,776 shares short as of July 15 (down 31.8% from the June 30 total), describing it as ~2.3% of shares outstanding with ~2.2 days to cover; Equibles separately shows 2.6M shares / 2.7% of float / 2.9 days to cover for early July — the two differ in both share count and denominator (float vs shares outstanding) and were not reconciled.

The on-file catalyst (2026-09-16, warning of a possible 5-10% Q3 earnings decline) appears to conflict with the actual reported Q3 2026 results (2026-10-15), which showed diluted EPS up 3.4% YoY rather than down — not independently reconciled this session; both are recorded rather than one being dropped.

Cash and the $750M senior-notes debt figure come directly from the Q2 2026 10-Q (period ended 2026-06-30); a Q3 2026 10-Q with more current balance-sheet figures had likely not yet been filed/indexed as of this research pass.
